posix.isdir: This path is a folder, not a file.
posix.enoent: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.

sec_null_byte.title: Blocked by security policy
sec_null_byte.body: The path contains a NUL byte that can spoof system calls. Security policy does not allow this and it cannot be overridden in settings.

sec_path_traversal.title: Blocked by security policy
sec_path_traversal.body: The path contains a pattern that tries to escape the workspace. Security policy does not allow this and it cannot be overridden in settings.

sec_symlink_escape.title: Symlink points outside the workspace
sec_symlink_escape.body: This symbolic link resolves outside the workspace. Security policy does not allow following it — copy the target into the workspace and open it from there.

bnd_outside_workspace.title: Path is outside the workspace
bnd_outside_workspace.body: This path is outside the current workspace and cannot be opened. Add the location as a workspace or move the file inside the current one.

prm_os_eacces.title: Permission denied by the OS
prm_os_eacces.body: The operating system denied read permission for this file. Check ownership and read permissions, then try again.

pol_vcs_internal.title: VCS internals are protected by default
pol_vcs_internal.body: Version-control internals such as .git, .hg, and .svn are protected by default. If you really need to edit them, add an entry to your allow list.

pol_node_modules.title: node_modules is protected by default
pol_node_modules.body: node_modules is auto-generated dependency content and is protected by default. Use the allow list in settings to expose specific packages.

pol_build_output.title: Build output is protected by default
pol_build_output.body: Build artifacts such as dist, build, and .next are auto-generated and protected by default. Use the allow list in settings to expose specific paths.

pol_lang_cache.title: Language caches are protected by default
pol_lang_cache.body: Runtime caches such as .venv, __pycache__, and .gradle are protected by default. Use the allow list in settings to expose specific paths.

pol_ide_internal.title: IDE internals are protected by default
pol_ide_internal.body: Editor metadata directories such as .idea, .vscode, and .cursor are protected by default. Files you typically edit (settings.json, rule files) are auto-allowed.

pol_platform_cruft.title: Platform cruft is protected by default
pol_platform_cruft.body: OS cruft files such as .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, and desktop.ini rarely need editing and are protected by default. Add an allow-list entry if you really need to open them.

prf_file_size_limit.title: File is too large ({{size}})
prf_file_size_limit.body: This file is {{size}}, which exceeds the stability limit ({{limit}}) and is blocked by default. Choose 'Open anyway' to open it once at your own risk.

prf_file_size_warn.title: Large file warning ({{size}})
prf_file_size_warn.body: This file is {{size}}, larger than typical, and is being opened anyway. If you notice input lag, try a different viewer.

prf_dir_node_count.title: Folder has too many entries ({{count}})
prf_dir_node_count.body: This folder has {{count}} immediate entries, which exceeds the limit ({{limit}}), so it is paginated by default. Narrow your view with search or filters.

fmt_not_utf8.title: Encoding cannot be decoded as text
fmt_not_utf8.body: This file is not valid UTF-8. Open it with another viewer or use 'View as text' to force-decode it.

fmt_is_directory.title: This path is a folder
fmt_is_directory.body: It is a folder, not a file, so the editor cannot open it. Expand the folder in the file tree and pick a file inside.

fmt_binary_sniff.title: Detected as a binary file
fmt_binary_sniff.body: The first bytes contain NUL, so this looks binary. Open it with an image or PDF viewer, or use 'View as text' if you are sure it is text.

io_disk_full.title: Disk is full
io_disk_full.body: Save failed because the disk is full. Free up space and try again.

io_enoent.title: File not found
io_enoent.body: The file at this path is missing. Another tool may have moved or deleted it — refresh the file tree to confirm.

io_unclassified.title: Unknown filesystem error
io_unclassified.body: An unclassified I/O error occurred (code: {{code}}). Retry shortly, or copy the diagnostics to report the issue.
